description: This is a Java source file defining the GSIMApplicationRejectionHandler class, which implements a command handler for rejecting GSIM (likely a savings account application). The class is annotated as a Spring Service and handles the 'REJECT' action for the 'GSIMACCOUNT' entity, delegating the rejection logic to a service.

classes.name: GSIMApplicationRejectionHandler
classes.description: A Spring service class that handles rejection commands for GSIM account applications, implementing the NewCommandSourceHandler interface.

methods.name: processCommand
methods.description: Processes the rejection command by delegating to the savingsAccountWritePlatformService to reject the GSIM application.
